subject: Inherit LDFLAGS for TLS and RDMA modules (#3344)
reason: The change is build-only: it adds $(LDFLAGS) to the Makefile link lines for the optional valkey-tls.so and valkey-rdma.so modules so externally supplied linker flags are inherited when building those shared objects. No source code, command behavior, reply, replication, persistence, or configuration path changes; against an already-compiled binary there is no behavioral difference a scenario could reach, so no test is needed.
